scope: Packaged-window smoke for Orbit Code through tauri-driver/WebDriver. Default mode verifies launch and workbench render; live Plan submit requires ORBIT_DESKTOP_PLAN_LIVE=1.

criteria.label: Host platform can drive the packaged Tauri window.
criteria.message: macOS cannot run Tauri WebDriver automation because WKWebView has no WebDriver implementation. Run this smoke on Linux/Windows CI.
